chunks: From one of the two Imams (peace be upon him), he said:
Any Muslim servant whom Allah (Glorified is His Majesty) tests with a misfortune and he bears patience, Allah will record for him the reward of one thousand martyrs.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a Muslim who patiently endures a trial or misfortune?
ai.summary: The Imam (a.s) states that a Muslim servant who endures a trial or misfortune with patience is granted the reward equivalent to one thousand martyrs. This highlights the high spiritual status of patience (sabr) in the face of adversity.
